causal-chain.def: The ordered links from a policy action to its result: for monetary policy, the tool, the policy rate, other interest rates, interest-sensitive spending, AD, then output, the price level and unemployment.

policy-mix.def: Fiscal and monetary policy used at the same time. When both push AD the same way the AD effect is clear but the interest rate effect may not be; when they push opposite ways the AD effect is indeterminate.
